review.method: Ordered candidate sweep of all polished turns; expanded full-turn context at selected decisions; supplementary numeric-clock/spatial sweep; focused semantic review; deterministic provenance checks.
review.limitation: Not an independent exhaustive semantic audit of every turn. Recall not measured. Source transcription uncertainty retained.

summary: Clear July 6–10 chronology, probable July 11 research visit, then loosely dated monastery downtime. YAML end July 13 remains unconfirmed.
issues: End date July 13 is compatible with loose downtime but not independently established.
Kassi on July 11 is inferred, not a spoken date.
Monastery is modeled within Tokra vicinity, not inside city walls. Kirian’s and Red Lily are distinct places.
